title: Escaping & Weaponizing The Turtle & Other Bottom Positions
whyUseful: Covers high-percentage movements for no-gi turtle defense, teaching how to create space, improve defensive posture, and transition back to Guard or standing position safely.

title: Recovering from the Turtle (Lachlan Giles)
whyUseful: Lachlan Giles explains his complete system for no-gi turtle defense and recovery. Focuses on movements to prevent back-takes and create openings to stand up or reguard, the gold standard for modern turtle escape.

title: JOZEF CHEN revolutionizing turtle “Stop Giving Up Your Back! Turtle Escape & Back-Exposure System
whyUseful: BJJ focus camps breaks down back exposure, another angle on Turtle Escape to Stand Up.
